subtitles.en: But obviously, local governments, they were very weak in their physical situation, commercial banks, the economy is weak, right?

subtitles.en: So I guess this is where the new momentum will come from. This is a direct state push.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为新的动能将来源于此。这是直接的国家推动。

subtitles.en: And you know, I think the strategy I think earlier this year was always, I'm going to sell China by Korea.

subtitles.en: Is that trade you think reversing now in some ways?

subtitles.en: So I think from, at least from a tactical point of view, the high-flying Taiwanese and the Korean market will likely take a pause.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，至少从战术角度来看，高歌猛进的台湾和韩国市场可能会暂停一下。

subtitles.en: And then the deeply depressed parts of EM, like China, Brazil, for example, they will do better going forward.

subtitles.en: So in terms of rotation, what are you looking and tilting towards to in the China equity market?

subtitles.en: Then if you're going overweight now in the fourth quarter, what could potentially be driving this market into the end of the year?
subtitles.zh: 如果你现在在第四季度增持，什么可能推动这个市场到年底？

subtitles.en: I think what we saw earlier, especially in the second quarter of this year, probably especially after the run-war, we can see the Chinese government really intentionally slowed down capital spending in infrastructure because we had positive surprise in Q1.
subtitles.zh: 我认为我们之前看到的，尤其是今年第二季度，可能特别是在那之后，我们可以看到中国政府确实有意放缓了基础设施的资本支出，因为我们在第一季度有积极的惊喜。

subtitles.en: And then probably Beijing was concerned that if they really increased spending in infrastructure, they would further push up cost pressure for companies.
subtitles.zh: 然后可能北京担心，如果他们真的增加基础设施支出，会进一步推高企业的成本压力。

subtitles.en: So I think like, so in Q4, I would expect some kind of capital intensive sectors to do better, especially they are coming from such a depressed starting point.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，在第四季度，我预计一些资本密集型板块会表现更好，尤其是它们来自如此低迷的起点。

subtitles.en: But also some other consumer sectors, consumer sectors, healthcare sectors, they were treating at very high multiples a few years ago. Now they have been completely washed out.
subtitles.zh: 但也有一些其他消费板块、医疗板块，几年前它们的估值倍数非常高。现在它们已经被完全洗出去了。

subtitles.en: So I think broadly speaking, we would expect a broad rally in the stock market, but some structure stories like consumer sector, healthcare sector were likely to do well.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为总体而言，我们预计市场将广泛上涨，但一些结构性故事，如消费板块、医疗板块可能表现良好。

subtitles.en: And some very kept intensive sectors, material, commodity-related sectors were also probably to well.
subtitles.zh: 还有一些资本密集型板块，材料、大宗商品相关板块也可能表现良好。

clips.speaker: Yang Wang
clips.title: Alpine Macro王岩：新兴市场金融板块迎来配置窗口？
title_lines: 货币政策周期带来顺风？

subtitles.en: I mean, maybe a bit of a separate story, but we have been seeing the past couple of sessions last week, especially on the hung saying the finance stocks getting hard hit because of some of these elevated yield financial condition concerns.
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，这可能有点不同，但我们看到上周过去几个交易日，尤其是在香港市场，金融板块受到严重打击，因为一些关于收益率上升和金融状况的担忧。

subtitles.en: Broadly speaking, if we talk about EM, EM financial, the relative performance of EM financials historically has had a very tight correlation with the monetary cycle in EM.
subtitles.zh: 总体而言，如果我们谈论新兴市场金融板块，历史上新兴市场金融板块的相对表现与新兴市场的货币周期有非常紧密的相关性。

subtitles.en: So this is actually quite ironic if central banks are tightening that on margin, it's good news for banks because that supports their profit margin, their net interest margin.
subtitles.zh: 所以这实际上相当讽刺，如果央行在边际上收紧，这对银行来说是好消息，因为这支持了它们的利润率，它们的净息差。

subtitles.en: So at the expense of corporate borrowers, corporate household borrowers, so actually one in the tightening cycle, financials tend to do better.
subtitles.zh: 所以以企业借款人、企业家庭借款人为代价，实际上在紧缩周期中，金融板块往往表现更好。

subtitles.en: So at this point actually, we think it makes sense to increase exposure to EM financials because now on margin, EMs under banks are moving towards a tightening cycle.
subtitles.zh: 所以实际上在这一点上，我们认为增加对新兴市场金融板块的敞口是有道理的，因为现在边际上，新兴市场的银行正朝着紧缩周期移动。

subtitles.en: And over time, this could lead to some kind of tailwind for EM financials.
subtitles.zh: 随着时间的推移，这可能为新兴市场金融板块带来某种顺风。

subtitles.en: So then the bond yields will probably stay community to rise. You know, obviously, from from allocation point of view, now bond yields are at this level, obviously, it becomes a lot more attractive from allocation point of view.
subtitles.zh: 那么债券收益率可能会继续上升。你知道，显然，从配置的角度来看，现在债券收益率处于这个水平，显然从配置角度来看变得更有吸引力。

subtitles.en: But I guess it really, you know, stock market has to really feel the pressure from rising yield for yields to come off. All right.

subtitles.en: They're being developed. Yes.
subtitles.zh: 它们正在开发中。是的。

subtitles.en: I think AI does make quant strategies, quant trading is more powerful.
subtitles.zh: 我认为AI确实让量化策略和量化交易更强大。

subtitles.en: As AI itself isn't an alpha, but it's a tool.
subtitles.zh: 因为AI本身不是超额收益，而是一种工具。

subtitles.en: It depends on how you use it.
subtitles.zh: 取决于你如何使用它。

subtitles.en: For example, we, I think we applied AI to our research platform quite early back to 2015.
subtitles.zh: 例如，我们早在2015年就将AI应用于我们的研究平台。

subtitles.en: And we do see the benefits from the result these days. Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 如今我们确实看到了成果带来的好处。是的。

subtitles.en: I mean, how do you look at the, there seems to be a bit of paradox, right?
subtitles.zh: 你怎么看，似乎有点矛盾，对吧？

subtitles.en: Because you look at how what analyst coverage is on some of these A share listed companies,
subtitles.zh: 因为你看一些内地上市公司的分析师覆盖情况，

subtitles.en: particularly when it comes to small caps, I think that's dwindled to just under 40% here right now.
subtitles.zh: 尤其是小盘股，我认为现在已经下降到略低于40%。

subtitles.en: But when you look at these bid-ass spreads, they're quite tight and quite tighter than most emerging markets out there here right now.
subtitles.zh: 但你看这些买卖价差，它们相当紧，比大多数新兴市场都要紧。

subtitles.en: How do you deal with that? And in some ways, do you think that it's a paradox in how you look at quant trading and quant strategies now? Yes.
subtitles.zh: 你如何应对？在某种程度上，你认为这是看待量化交易和量化策略的矛盾吗？是的。

subtitles.en: I think now people always ask, is there still alpha as it's getting crowded, there's alpha squeeze. Yes, there's still alpha, but the lazy alpha, the easy alpha is going to be retired.
subtitles.zh: 我认为现在人们总是问，随着市场变得拥挤，超额收益是否还存在，存在超额收益压缩。是的，仍然有超额收益，但懒惰的、容易的超额收益将退场。

subtitles.en: And it depends on where you look for it and how you define the alpha.
subtitles.zh: 这取决于你在哪里寻找以及如何定义超额收益。

subtitles.en: There's also always a new alpha because of the new policy, new environment.
subtitles.zh: 由于新政策、新环境，总会有新的超额收益。

subtitles.en: And you cannot rely on one factor, one strategy, one model.
subtitles.zh: 你不能依赖单一因子、单一策略、单一模型。

subtitles.en: So we train our system to adapt to the market and to the changes.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们训练我们的系统去适应市场和变化。

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
